transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

They... they brought me in after what happened at the fair. I was giving a talk, and I got up on the tractor and started jerking the controls around, trying to show people some new pattern. Folks were yelling at me to stop, but I... I couldn’t seem to stop myself.
Can you describe what you mean by not being able to stop yourself? Were you aware of what you were doing, or did it feel like your body was moving without your control?

I knew I was up there. I could hear people yelling. But it was like… once I started moving those controls, showing that pattern, I just couldn’t make myself quit. My hands kept doing it, and I didn’t listen.
When you were moving the tractor controls, did it feel like you were not in control of your body, or was it more like you couldn’t stop yourself even though you knew you should?

More like… I knew I should stop. I wasn’t gone or anything. But I’d climbed up there and started jerking the controls to show that new pattern, and even with folks yelling, I just… kept doing it. Couldn’t make myself quit.
Were there any moments during this incident where you felt like you didn’t know what you were doing, or like you were watching yourself from outside your body?
No… I don’t think so. I knew I was up on that tractor. I knew folks were yelling. I just… kept working the controls, trying to show that pattern, and I couldn’t make myself stop.
During the time you were on the tractor and moving the controls, did you see, hear, or feel anything that others wouldn’t have, like voices or strange sensations?

Yeah… sometimes I hear things. Not right then maybe, but out by the north pasture, near dusk, I hear voices coming from the irrigation lines. Clear enough. They’ll say which rows are poisoned or blessed. It’s… not something I like talking about. And it happens even when I’m not all wound up.
When you hear those voices from the irrigation lines, do you believe they are giving you information that others don’t know or can’t understand, like messages that only you can act on?

I guess… yeah. It sounds like they know something about the rows. Like which ones are poisoned or blessed. It’s clearest out by the north pasture, near dusk. And it’s not only when I’m all fired up, either.
When you hear the voices from the irrigation lines, do you believe they are telling you things that others couldn’t know, like hidden truths or special instructions meant only for you?

Yeah… I mean, it’s not just the voices. I know it sounds like nothing to other people, but the odd numbers in the yield maps, and those drone reports… they’re not random. Even when my wife shows me the lender’s regular paperwork, I can see there’s warnings in there. Like folks are trying to take the farm out from under me.
Do you feel like these warnings and messages you’re receiving are part of a larger plan or plot directed at you specifically?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t like saying it, but those numbers in the yield maps, the drone reports… even the lender papers my wife says are plain… they look like warnings to me. Like it’s all tied together, aimed at getting the farm away from me.
Do you ever feel like your actions are being controlled by something or someone else, like you're a puppet or being guided by an outside force?
I don’t know… controlled, like a puppet? I wouldn’t put it that way. Sometimes I feel pushed to pay attention to things, but… no, I’m not sure someone’s moving me around.
Do you believe that certain events, objects, or people in your life are specifically trying to send you messages or harm you, like they’re all part of a plan against you?

Yeah… I do. I know it sounds strange, but those odd numbers in the yield maps, the drone reports… they feel coded. Even when my wife shows me the lender’s paperwork and says it’s just plain forms, I can see warnings in it. Like people are lining things up to take the farm from me.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts, feelings, or actions were being controlled by an outside force, like someone or something else was making you do things without your permission?
I… no, I don’t think like that. I don’t feel like something’s making me do things. Sometimes I get a bad feeling or feel pressured, but my thoughts and actions still feel like mine.
Have you ever felt that thoughts are being placed in your mind that aren’t yours, or that things happening around you have a special meaning meant only for you?

Not thoughts put in my head, no… I wouldn’t say that. But things around me, yeah, they can feel meant for me. Like the odd numbers in the yield maps, the drone reports… even when my wife says the lender papers are just regular paperwork, I know there are warnings in there. Like folks are trying to take the farm out from under me.
Have you ever felt that things happening around you, like events or objects, were directly related to you in a special or personal way, even if others didn’t see it that way?

Yeah… I mean, I’ve said some of it. The yield maps, the drone reports… certain numbers in there don’t feel random to me. Even the lender papers my wife says are just plain paperwork, I can see warnings in them. Like it’s all pointing at me… at the farm being taken.
Do you feel like everyday things, like numbers on a page or events around you, are secretly about you or meant only for you, even if others don’t see it that way?

Yeah… I guess so. The odd numbers in the yield maps, the drone reports… they’re not just numbers to me. Even when my wife shows me the lender papers and says they’re plain, I can tell there are warnings in there. Like people are trying to take the farm.
